content.text:
Built and rendered — no layout defects at any size.

- **Structure:** one full-bleed root frame (width/height `fill`, clips) as a column stack, so every band spans the full canvas at all three sizes.
- **Photo band:** `fit: cover` with `flexGrow: 1` — it crops (13% / 56% height, 19% width) instead of distorting and absorbs the leftover height differences between 1350, 1000 and the tall 300×600.
- **Candidates:** three `flexGrow: 1` columns, so they stay evenly spaced and centered at every width.
- **Sky (scale 0.28):** `media` overrides bump headline, names, roles, steps, CTA and icons so nothing drops below ~10.6px; "Omar Haddad" no longer wraps.

Renders: `portrait-v6.png`, `wide-v6.png`, `sky-v6.png`.
